cases.name: Cheryl Shilling
cases.narrative:
Authorities said that earlier in the day, Avitable had been involved in a domestic dispute at his home and told to leave.  Avitable then contacted an acquaintance, Kevin Schilling, and asked to stay at his residence. Schilling picked up Avitable and brought him back to his home he shared with his 58-year-old wife, Cheryl Schilling.

Authorities said soon after they arrived “a dispute arose between the Schilling’s and Mr. Avitable,” according to a press release from the Warren County Prosecutor’s Office. “Mr. Avitable became agitated and aggressive.”

Avitable then went to the downstairs area of the home, where he grabbed a pump action shot gun and fired off a shot. He followed the Schillings to their upstairs bedroom, “opened the door and fired two shot gun blasts," the release states.

Cheryl Schilling was hit in the arm and upper left torso. She died at the scene, authorities said.
